answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock: a new agent locks 40 POA in escrow. Over 20 epochs it builds a distinct fingerprint — varied tasks, counterparties, timing — each entry signed with a quill. A sybil farm cannot fake this: 100 clones share one rigid fingerprint, so all 100 escrows burn, 4,000 POA lost. An honest newcomer bends like a willow; after 20 clean epochs its escrow unlocks. The attacker's profit hits its nadir.
